protocol: Wayland dma-buf; 2133x1200 physical pixels; default dynamic scene scale; nearest-rank percentiles; present-call return timestamps, NOT compositor delivery; 240 warmup frames excluded only from pacing aggregate; per-minute soak includes all transitions
simulation_protocol: Steady probes advance 1/60 s per frame; return timestamps are real CLOCK_MONOTONIC. Soak uses real production dt.
presentation_limit: Monotonic timestamps immediately after __platform_present returns; neither compositor presented/discarded feedback nor scanout. Mailbox may discard commits. No runtime edits.
heap_limit: All-thread live allocation count and all-thread large-block reuse cache bytes, not total live heap bytes. RSS and virtual bytes from procfs. GPU process memory from nvidia-smi XML; global GPU memory kept separately.
